action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with budget 100 and no incumbent; probing (~12% of budget) will reveal modality/smoothness while populating the archive. Deterministic, cheap evaluations make probes especially cost-effective at this stage.

Probes show moderate fitness-distance correlation (fdc_spearman=0.6993) but best points are fairly spread (top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.7431) with a huge value range (log10_range=5.297), suggesting multiple basins with some smoothness. In 10D with cheap, deterministic evaluations and 88 evals left, racing TuRBO vs CMA-ES hedges between local trust-region BO and a strong global evolutionary baseline. The incumbent is 6273.05 after 12 probe evals, so a short race (36 evals) should identify the better driver before spending the bulk of the budget.

TuRBO won the race decisively (2265.19 vs 3351.83) and hasn’t been continued yet (evals_in_tenure=0) with a healthy tr_length=0.8 and not exhausted. With 58 evals left and strong structure indicated (fdc_spearman=0.6993), continuing TuRBO to exploit the current basin is the highest-upside move before any polishing.

Only 8 evaluations remain on a deterministic 10D problem, so we should spend them on local refinement. Probes indicate a smooth, funnel-like landscape (fdc_spearman=0.6993), and TuRBO with tr_length=0.05 improved only 172.5 over 50 evals; polishing from the incumbent (2092.72) is likely to yield the best final gains.
